# Kimchipremium

> Korea crypto premium tracker for BTC, ETH, XRP.

## About
Kimchipremium is a free, privacy-first online tool. No login, no tracking.

## Why
- 100% free
- Privacy-first
- Mobile responsive
- Multi-language EN/KO/JA
- Fast global CDN
- AI-friendly structured data
